exposure: capillary blood glucose after 75g oral glucose tolerance test
venous plasma glucose after 75g oral glucose tolerance test
cohort: Pregnant women between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation at the ESI-PGIMSR, ESIC Medical College, JOKA, Kolkata, India.
finding: Capillary blood glucose measurement had high sensitivity (86.36%), specificity (95.31%), and accuracy (94%) for diagnosing gestational diabetes mellitus compared to venous plasma glucose using WHO criteria.
